visual_action: A slideshow of six static graphics, each congratulating a different Democratic candidate for winning a gubernatorial election. The graphics share a common design: a photo of the politician against a colorful gradient background with faint stars. The politicians featured are Josh Shapiro (PA), Kathy Hochul (NY), Tony Evers (WI), Tina Kotek (OR), JB Pritzker (IL), and Janet Mills (ME).
